title: Place effects, mist, and fog
summary: Assign FX markers, paint local mist, and tune global fog.
outcome: Effects and atmospheric settings attached to the map.

sections.title: Place an effect marker

steps.title: Choose an effect
steps.text: Open the FX browser, Choose library… if needed, search an asset, and drag it into a viewport to place an FX marker.

steps.title: Set playback
steps.text: Select the marker in the Entities inspector. Browse… or enter the exact asset name, choose Apply reference, then select At map start or When called from a map script and Apply playback.

steps.title: Link a scripted effect
steps.text: For script playback, give the marker a unique script key. After map FX startup, call the generated map FX trigger with that key from your script.

tips: Use the camera FX toggle to preview map effects. Trigger keys must be unique, including those inside prefabs.

sections.title: Paint local mist

steps.title: Choose mist
steps.text: Open the Painter inspector’s Local mist tool and its FX library. The tool uses the Dense mist preset, creating it from room_smoke_200 when first needed.

steps.title: Paint or erase
steps.text: Click a camera surface for one patch or drag for spaced patches. Switch to Erase and set Erase radius to remove mist placed with this tool.

tips: Erase affects only mist made by this painter. Each stroke is one undoable edit.

sections.title: Tune global fog

steps.title: Open camera fog controls
steps.text: Use the fog button above the camera, enable fog, and set start distance, half distance, maximum opacity, and color. Review any field error before building.

tips: Camera fog is an approximation of the in-game result.
